results.title: Return of the King: The Fall and Rise of Elvis Presley
results.original_title: Return of the King: The Fall and Rise of Elvis Presley
results.overview: He had one chance to show the world he was still the King of Rock 'n' Roll. Discover the story behind Elvis Presley's triumphant '68 comeback special.

results.title: My Boo
results.overview: Joe finds a way to make some cash out of the creepy old house he inherited. But he didn't think he'd find love with one of the ghosts haunting it.

results.title: Pointe Noire
results.overview: Cajun filmmaker Louis Leger and attorney Dolores Arceneaux join forces in the Cajun prairie community of Pointe Noire in an effort to save the life of Joel Richard, a falsely accused Cajun man on Louisiana's Death Row.

results.title: Saigon Kiss
results.overview: Mo navigates rush hour traffic to dodge an unwanted call. When she meets Vicky by the side of the street with her broken motorbike, a visceral chance encounter unfolds between the two young queer women on the loud streets of Saigon.

results.title: Disposal
results.overview: A man's workplace suddenly shutters, starting a chain reaction.

results.title: The Grey Men
results.overview: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

results.title: Clawface
results.overview: A group of friends, a duo of quirky park rangers, a frisky couple and a pirate DJ unknowingly set off a series of bloody murders when they enter the woods of local legend, Clawface: a hulking madman who was left for dead after a bear attack in his youth. Inspired by slasher films of the 1980s.

results.title: Ramy Youssef: More Feelings
results.overview: Ramy Youssef reflects on issues big and small–from global events to his childhood book report to finding unity in our divided world.

results.title: Yes Mistress
results.overview: A dominant and a submissive tests their boundaries and explore their sexual desires in various exchanges of power.

results.title: Leydi Di
results.overview: When Nevzat, an honest financial advisor, is drawn into a risky fraud scheme by his adopted son, his life is thrown into chaos.

results.title: Dalia and the Red Book
results.overview: Dalia, the daughter of a famous writer who has recently died, inherits the legacy of finishing his book. To do this, Dalia will become part of the book and will come face to face with the characters who have taken the theme of the book in order to be the protagonists.

results.title: Cold Road
results.overview: On a frozen remote highway in the Canadian North, an Indigenous woman and her dog are hunted by a stranger in a semi truck.

results.title: Inheritance
results.overview: Ruth, a 37-year-old has taken care of her ailing mother for years, to the detriment of her personal and professional life. Now that her mother is on the verge of dying, Ruth suddenly finds herself inside her mother’s subconscious and through some key memories, learns to let go, and realizes that it’s not too late for her to start over.

results.title: Omakase
results.overview: A woman is wined and dined by a head chef who has sinister motives.

results.title: Kampana
results.overview: Life is good at Padre Pi's town because of his magical bell. But what about the other towns? Society will crumble in our 11-minute short film.

results.title: Throuple
results.overview: Ysay and Hannah, who were in a throuple relationship, find themselves searching for a new partner after losing their boyfriend. Will they find the perfect third piece?

results.title: El Facilitador
results.overview: This documentary addresses two political scandals that marked Luis Lacalle Pou's administration: Alejandro Astesiano and Sebastián Marset, two names that were previously unknown to most citizens.

results.title: The End
results.overview: Twenty-five years after environmental collapse left the Earth uninhabitable, Mother, Father and Son are confined to their palatial bunker, where they struggle to maintain hope and a sense of normalcy by clinging to the rituals of daily life—until the arrival of a stranger, Girl, upends their happy routine. As tensions rise, their seemingly idyllic existence starts to crumble.
